summary: Ignore unclaimed stale ticket scopes in worktree overlap guard

delivery.outcome: Worktree overlap governance ignores unclaimed historical ticket copies while preserving branch-owned scope and real path collision detection.
nonGoals: Do not infer terminal lifecycle state for stale tickets
Do not weaken dirty or committed path collision checks

architecture.decision: Attribute scope only from a matching ticket branch or an actual change to that ticket directory; leave signal-free historical copies unowned.
architecture.rollback: Revert this ticket to restore the conservative all-checkout fallback.

validation.evidence: The fixture produces no extra finding for an unclaimed stale ticket.
The same fixture retains exactly one branch-owned overlap finding.
